description: This file defines a Razor Pages PageModel class 'ConfirmEmailModel' used for email confirmation in the Identity area of an ASP.NET Core web application. It handles email confirmation logic via UserManager, checking user existence, and confirming email with provided code.

classes.name: ConfirmEmailModel
classes.description: A Razor Pages PageModel class responsible for processing email confirmation requests in the Identity area.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Handles GET requests to confirm the user's email by userId and confirmation code; redirects if parameters are null, verifies user, and confirms email.
